from.place: proof step (c): differential of [d] is multiplication by d on the tangent space

title: Differential of multiplication by d
statement: Let G be a commutative group scheme [def-sc-group-scheme] over a field k, e its identity, and d\geq1. The tangent map at e of the multiplication morphism [d]:G\to G is the scalar multiplication map v\mapsto d\cdot v on T_{G/k,e}.

source.place: Groupoid Schemes, proof of lemma-group-scheme-addition-tangent-vectors applied inductively to [d]
